title: Standard tame charts for the local normalization over a trait
statement: Let S be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, and c:C→S a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let G be finite with order invertible in Γ(S,O_S), and let Z→Cη be a finite etale G-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], where Cη→Spec k(S) and Cη→C exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let U⊆S contain η and let P→C_U be finite etale, identified with Z on the generic fibre by a cartesian comparison compatible with Cη→C. Let s∉U be minimal outside U among its generalizations, and assume A=O_{S,s} is a DVR. Put L=C×_S Spec A and let n:N×_C L→L be the pullback of the concrete relative normalization N→C of P→C_U→C. If n is finite, there is a jointly surjective family of affine etale maps φ_i:Spec R_i→L such that each pullback of n is isomorphic OVER Spec R_i to Spec(∏_{k∈Fin m_i} R_i[T]/(T^{e_{i,k}}-f_i)), with one f_i∈R_i common to all its factors, e_{i,k}>0 and e_{i,k} invertible in R_i. The family is indexed by a type in the universe of the schemes; m_i=0 is allowed.

proof.text: Use the localization comparison to obtain a generic G-torsor W on the generic fibre of the local smooth family d:L -> Spec A, and an isomorphism beta from the concrete pullback normalization to its generic normalization, commuting with the structure maps to L.

Apply the germ map from global sections to the stalk to transport invertibility of the group order to A. Since beta is an isomorphism over L, its inverse followed by n is the generic normalization map; this makes that map finite. The second projection d is smooth and qcqs by base change.
Apply the pointwise generic trait chart theorem to each point x of L.

Choose a chart for each x and index the family by the underlying type of L. Its chosen point maps to x, so it is jointly surjective. For each chart pull back beta using pullback.map with the identity maps on the chart and L. This map is an isomorphism because its three components are isomorphisms. Compose this pullback isomorphism with the standard-root isomorphism. The pullback second-projection identity gives the required equality over Spec R. The same construction includes empty L and empty component products.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_charts {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    IsFinite n →
      ∃ (I : Type u) (R : I → CommRingCat.{u})
        (φ : ∀ i, Spec (R i) ⟶ pullback c a),
        (∀ i, Etale (φ i)) ∧
        (∀ x : ↥(pullback c a), ∃ (i : I) (y : Spec (R i)), φ i y = x) ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : R i) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
          (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : R i)) ∧
          ∃ α : pullback n (φ i) ≅
            Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
              AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial (R i)) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f))),
            α.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap (R i) (∀ k : Fin m,
                AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial (R i)) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f)))) =
              pullback.snd n (φ i)
